name: Illinois
agency: IDHS Family Community Resource Center (HFS handles Pay-In payments)

period.description: Your spenddown is a monthly amount; you get coverage for each month you meet it.

submission.description: Give your bills and receipts to your IDHS caseworker at the Family Community Resource Center. People who are 65+, blind or disabled and live at home can instead pay the amount to HFS (Pay-In Spenddown), or mix both, choosing each month.

notes: Never send bills or receipts to the Pay-In Spenddown Unit. Bills go to your caseworker; payments go to HFS.
Pay-In accepts money order, cashier's check, Visa or MasterCard, not personal checks.
Unused parts of a paid receipt can be used in later months, up to six months after you paid.
Unpaid bills count if dated no earlier than six months before the month you use them.
